periods.time: vol-09 ch-004, evening third-round first match

name.zh: 黑铁王马击溃加我恋司

periods.summary: Ouma defeats Renji Kaga despite Renji's hidden six-armed steel form, then crushes his heart before Kurono saves him with Clock Lock.
periods.cause: Renji has trained for five years to settle his childhood rivalry with Ouma and wants a true life-risking fight against him.
periods.process: Renji enters in his Device mawashi, demonstrates extreme force control with sumo stamping, and reveals Iron Block Asura Statue, giving himself six steel arms for Asura Hyakka Palm. Ouma walks straight into the attack, withstands every blow, and reveals he had merely lowered his body to swing. He cuts off Renji's added and original arms and legs, then pierces his chest and crushes his heart before the referee can stop him.
periods.outcome: Kurono Shinguji freezes Renji's body with Clock Lock and orders medical staff to move him to a regenerative capsule, preventing death. Ouma advances to face Stella in the semifinal.
periods.aftermath: The arena is horrified by Ouma's ruthlessness. Stella alone applauds, interpreting the lethal thoroughness as proof Ouma treated Renji's challenge seriously, and vows to force out his full power.
casualties: renji-kaga limbs severed and heart crushed, saved by Clock Lock and regeneration
periods.significance: Establishes Ouma's frightening level before the Stella semifinal and contrasts ruthless serious combat with spectator expectations of sport.
